# Golden Lady

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

The Golden Lady is distinguished by her long golden hair, which reaches all the way down to her feet. She wears a dress that glitters and glistens, resembling living gold.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)_

## Personality

The Golden Lady spends her time continuously playing a golden harp. Her music can be heard along the shore by attentive listeners, though it is frequently mistaken for the sound of the wind blowing through the rocks.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)_

## Traits

_Not yet known._

## Abilities

- plays on a golden harp all day long  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

The Golden Lady of the cave is an imaginary character created by young [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). According to Paul's stories, she lives in a shore cave and joins him on magical adventures, such as sailing into a moonglade to visit the sunset land. However, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) later clarifies that she and his other shore companions are purely fictional.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P45](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0045), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P46](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0046), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P3](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0003), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P6](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0006), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P9](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0009), +20 more_
